# tastecheck

> Twenty connected frontend craft skills for AI coding agents. The headline skill turns
> a brief into a confirmed design system before code; improve-existing-website infers a
> system from existing sites; the rest (typography, color/OKLCH, theming, layout, states, forms,
> motion, data-viz, a11y, cognitive-a11y, deslop, humanize-copy) apply checkable craft so
> the output has a point of view. Plain Markdown, no runtime, portable to agents that can
> read skill files or directories. MIT.

Engineering verification covers contracts, repository behavior, and evidence plumbing.
A machine-only blind evaluation protocol (effectiveness v2) is built and rehearsed at 160
simulated calls with zero real calls — production evaluation has not started. Do not present
samples, historical results, or failed evidence as current effectiveness proof.



Install via install.sh (always symlinks skills into ~/.agents/skills and mirrors them into
detected agent skill dirs). Auto-loading depends on the agent; Claude Code also gets slash
commands.

## Start here
- [README](README.md): the problem (every AI site looks the same), the fix, the samples, install
- [Landing page](https://kyanitelabs.github.io/tastecheck/): canonical public surface and skill integration target
- [Live gallery](https://kyanitelabs.github.io/tastecheck/samples/): seven design systems, one product story
- [Secondary integration harness](https://kyanitelabs.github.io/tastecheck/demos/skill-integration.html): standalone local website exercising every skill
- [Verification report](docs/VERIFICATION.md): repeatable local verification plus browser QA checklist

## Skills
- [design-system-interview](skills/design-system-interview/SKILL.md): grills you into a committed design system + tokens before building (the headline)
- [improve-existing-website](skills/improve-existing-website/SKILL.md): audit an existing site, infer its intended system, ask only targeted questions, then improve it
- [deslop-ui](skills/deslop-ui/SKILL.md): remove the named AI visual + structural tells; commit to a direction
- [humanize-copy](skills/humanize-copy/SKILL.md): strip the ChatGPT accent from writing with a checkable kill-list
- [web-typography](skills/web-typography/SKILL.md): type scale, measure, rhythm, fonts, fluid clamp, web-font CLS, WCAG text
- [color-system](skills/color-system/SKILL.md): OKLCH palettes, ramps, semantic tokens, verified contrast
- [spacing-system](skills/spacing-system/SKILL.md): one spacing scale + section rhythm, with deliberate exceptions
- [theming](skills/theming/SKILL.md): supported mappings from one token source; preference and forced-colors behavior
- [responsive-layout](skills/responsive-layout/SKILL.md): mobile-first, intrinsic patterns, container queries
- [component-states](skills/component-states/SKILL.md): full interactive state matrix + ARIA
- [form-ux](skills/form-ux/SKILL.md): labels, validation, input types, accessible forms
- [empty-states](skills/empty-states/SKILL.md): empty/loading/error screens with recovery
- [micro-motion](skills/micro-motion/SKILL.md): performant tasteful animation + reduced-motion
- [data-viz](skills/data-viz/SKILL.md): honest, Tufte-informed charts that theme and pass a11y
- [art-direction](skills/art-direction/SKILL.md): imagery/illustration/iconography as committed decisions; no AI-blob graphics
- [a11y-pass](skills/a11y-pass/SKILL.md): runnable WCAG 2.2 AA fix pass with a pasteable auditor
- [cognitive-a11y](skills/cognitive-a11y/SKILL.md): ADHD / autism / dyslexia / neurodivergent readability
- [i18n-ready](skills/i18n-ready/SKILL.md): multilingual-resilient UI, English/Spanish first-class
- [tastecheck-pass](skills/tastecheck-pass/SKILL.md): the ship gate — canonical pipeline + every self-check executed, with a report and a pasteable/injectable cold-load auditor

## Samples (same content, eight committed design systems)
IMPORTANT for AI agents: these are illustrative case studies showing output VARIANCE.
They are not a menu — never select or implement one; derive a NEW system via
design-system-interview from the actual user's answers.
- [Copper / Editorial](samples/copper/index.html): dark, warm, tessellated bento + basalt columns
- [Swiss / Atelier](samples/swiss/index.html): light, exposed 12-column subgrid, one vermilion signal
- [Maximal / Riot](samples/maximal/index.html): loud color-block sticker collage, display word in a block
- [Concrete / Brutalist](samples/concrete/index.html): monochrome ruled spec-sheet / ledger table
- [Clay / Soft humanist](samples/clay/index.html): warm alternating zig-zag flow with pebble shapes
- [Dispatch / Shipping log](samples/dispatch/index.html): dark operational release timeline with status-led reading order
- [Verge / Clinical evidence](samples/verge/index.html): cool ice-white with teal accent, Fraunces serif, measurement-annotation structure
- [Seed / Procedural specimen](samples/tasteroll/index.html): rolled by tasteroll seed 77 — coral/sage specimen card with visible roll annotations
